SELECT A.STATUS, A.STATUS_TEXT, A.GR_NO, A.STDCATLG_ID, A.DESCRIPTION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.PO_QTY, A.WMS_IVK_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.PO_REMARK, A.IK_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.SPECIFICATION, A.GR_DATE, A.WMS_GR_QTY, A.INV_DATE, A.UNIT_AMT, A.BUYER, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.GR_SEQ, A.IK_SEQ, A.DOC_TYPE, A.MASTER_ITEM, A.IMG_NO, A.LIST_PRICE, A.PROCESS_TYPE
FROM ( SELECT PODT.STATUS AS STATUS, DECODE(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0,'출고예정','분할출고예정') AS STATUS_TEXT, IVDT.INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID , PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, '' AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, '' AS INV_DATE, NVL(((NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)),0) AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, '' AS IK_SEQ, POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, PODT.AGENT_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND (PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} OR POHD.AGENT=#{st_warehouse_agent}) AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY > 0 AND IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY <> IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY UNION ALL SELECT PODT.STATUS AS STATUS, DECODE(WIDT.INV_QTY,WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,'배송확정',DECODE(WIDT.GR_QTY,WIDT.INV_QTY,'출고','분할출고')) AS STATUS_TEXT, IVDT.INV_NO AS GR_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID , PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0) AS PO_QTY, NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) AS WMS_GR_QTY, WIDT.INV_DATE AS INV_DATE, NVL(((NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)),0) AS UNIT_AMT,
PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS GR_SEQ, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ,
POHD.DOC_TYPE AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, WIDT.LIST_PRICE, WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE
FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, WMSIVDT WIDT WHERE POHD.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND POHD.PO_NO =#{st_po_no} AND (PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} OR POHD.AGENT=#{st_warehouse_agent}) AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = WIDT.S_INV_NO AND IVDT.INV_SEQ = WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' ) A
ORDER BY A.BUYER,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ
ORDER BY A.STATUS_TEXT,A.BUYER,A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ

SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER)) AS COM_NAME, POHD.PO_NO AS PO_NO, MAX(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, MAX(PODT.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, MAX(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PODT.RD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD')-2,'YYYYMMDD')) AS GR_DATE_RE, MAX(DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반')) AS DOC_TEXT, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL) AS ADD_USER_TEL, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, MAX(POHD.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, MAX(POHD.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE, MAX(POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX(POHD.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE
FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE POHD.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND POHD.PO_NO =#{st_po_no} AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ GROUP BY POHD.BUYER, POHD.PO_NO

UPDATE WMSIVDT WIDT SET WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), WIDT.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{user_id}, WIDT.STATUS = 'D'
WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WIDT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND WIDT.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

UPDATE WMSSTCK SET AVAIL_QTY = NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0) + #{INV_QTY}, ALLOC_QTY = NVL(ALLOC_QTY,0) - (#{INV_QTY}), STC_SELLER_PRICE = ROUND(DECODE(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+#{INV_QTY},0,0,((NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)*NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0))+(#{INV_QTY}*#{LIST_PRICE}))/(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+#{INV_QTY})),0) WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND AGENT = DECODE(#{PROCESS_TYPE} ,'1','KRKORE0001','3',(SELECT WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ}) )

UPDATE WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = NVL(TOT_QTY,0) + #{INV_QTY}, AVAIL_QTY = NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0) + #{INV_QTY}, STC_SELLER_PRICE = ROUND(DECODE(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+ #{INV_QTY},0,0,((NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)*NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0))+( #{INV_QTY}*#{LIST_PRICE}))/(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+#{INV_QTY})),0) WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND AGENT = DECODE(#{PROCESS_TYPE},'1','KRKORE0001','3',(SELECT WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ}) )

UPDATE WMSSTCK SET AVAIL_QTY = NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0) + #{INV_QTY}, ALLOC_QTY = NVL(ALLOC_QTY,0) - (#{INV_QTY}), STC_SELLER_PRICE = DECODE(NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)+#{INV_QTY},0,0,NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0)) WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND AGENT = DECODE(#{PROCESS_TYPE},'1','KRKORE0001','3',(SELECT WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ}) )
